name: Alpha Pagination Sample View
description: Ships a ready-made example View demonstrating Alpha Pagination against the article content type.
project_description: Submodule of Alpha Pagination. On install it imports a single example View (views.view.alpha_pagination_sample, path /alpha-pagination-sample) that lists published article nodes with a Global: Alpha Pagination header, a glossary contextual filter on the title, and individual 0-9 numeric items. It exists purely as a working reference for configuring Alpha Pagination and relies on the default 'article' content type and the node body field; populate content (e.g. with Devel) to see letters activate.
